title: Manager - Demand Planner
jobDescription: Job Title- Manager - Demand Planner About us- With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, we’re the world’s leading premium drinks company. Bring your passion and use your curiosity as you explore, collaborate, and innovate to build brands consumers love. Together with passionate people from all over the world, you’ll test new ideas, learn and grow, and unlock a brighter, more exciting future. Join us to create a career worth celebrating About the Function: Supply Chain & Manufacturing is where our brands are made, moved and delivered to the world. It’s fast-paced and hands-on, with teams working together to ensure quality, efficiency and sustainability at every stage. Role plays an essential role in the supply chain function by using analytical, marketing, and sales data of a company to effectively estimating future product demands and drive the demand planning process. S/he will also play a critical role in driving the digital transformation of supply chain processes, leveraging existing and new platforms and tools to enhance planning capabilities for effective response to dynamic market environment KRAs: Manage the monthly Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) process with regions by balancing supply and demand Work closely with region commercial team to provide accurate forecasts. Create seamless flow of demand plan & deliver high level of customer service Be an important stakeholder for commercial leaders to help delivering business growth while optimizing supply chain. title: Manager - EHS (Large)
jobDescription: Job Title: Manager - EHS (Large) Manager – Health, Safety & Environment (HSE) Department: Manufacturing / EHS Location: Manufacturing Plant Industry: Alcoholic Beverage (Distillery / IMFL / Bottling) Role Purpose To lead and drive the Health, Safety & Environment agenda at the manufacturing unit by ensuring full compliance with statutory regulations, corporate global safety policies, and industry best practices. The role is responsible for managing safety in a hazardous manufacturing environment , ensuring safe handling of flammable materials such as ENA, implementing safety standards, and building a strong safety culture across employees and contractors. Key Responsibilities 1. Safety Leadership & Governance Lead implementation of the plant Health & Safety Management System aligned with corporate global safety policies and standards. Promote a strong safety culture through risk assessment, hazard identification, and behavior-based safety programs . Ensure strict adherence to critical safety systems including: Permit to Work (PTW) Lockout Tagout (LOTO) Confined Space Entry Work at Height Hot Work Safety Contractor Safety Management 2. Hazardous Process Safety Management Ensure compliance with statutory provisions related to hazardous processes under the Factories Act 1948 and applicable state factory rules. Ensure safe storage, transfer, and handling of ENA, chemicals, and flammable liquids used in alcobev manufacturing. Implement robust Process Safety Management (PSM) practices including: Hazard Identification & Risk Assessment (HIRA) Process Hazard Analysis (PHA) Safety interlock systems Monitor safety risks in distillation, blending, bottling, utilities, and warehouses . 3. Fire & Explosion Risk Management Ensure adequate fire protection systems considering highly flammable ethanol environments . Maintain and monitor fire safety systems including: Fire hydrant systems Foam-based firefighting systems Fire detection and alarm systems Conduct regular fire risk assessments and mock emergency drills . 4. Statutory Compliance & Regulatory Management Ensure compliance with applicable regulations including: Factories Act 1948 Maharashtra Factories Rules 1963 Guidelines from Directorate of Industrial Safety and Health (DISH) Maintain statutory safety registers, accident records, and compliance documentation. Ensure timely closure of observations raised during regulatory inspections. 5. Safety Boiler & Utilities Ensure safe operation and compliance of boilers, steam systems, and utilities used in the manufacturing plant. Ensure compliance under the Indian Boilers Act 1923 and guidelines from the Directorate of Boilers . Monitor safety of: Steam pressure systems Boiler fuel systems Safety valves and pressure control devices Ensure operation of boilers by certified boiler operators and maintain related statutory records. 6. Government Liaison & Statutory Inspections Liaise with government authorities including: Factory Inspector / DISH officials Directorate of Boilers Fire Department Coordinate statutory inspections, approvals, and compliance reporting. Ensure closure of regulatory observations in a timely manner. 7. Incident Investigation & Risk Control Lead investigation of incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions . Conduct root cause analysis and implement Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) . Conduct regular safety audits, inspections, and risk assessments . 8. Safety Monitoring, Reporting & Analytics Prepare and submit monthly safety performance reports and dashboards to corporate leadership. Monitor safety KPIs such as: Lost Time Injury Frequency Rate (LTIFR) Near miss reporting Unsafe acts/conditions Provide recommendations to improve plant safety performance. 9. Emergency Preparedness & Disaster Management Develop and maintain On-site Emergency Plan for hazardous operations. Conduct mock drills for fire, explosion, chemical spills, and evacuation scenarios . Ensure readiness of firefighting equipment, emergency response teams, and first aid systems . 10. Safety Training & Culture Development Conduct regular safety training, toolbox talks, and awareness programs for employees and contractors. Lead safety campaigns to improve employee engagement and safety ownership . Ensure competency development for employees handling hazardous materials. Qualifications Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering / Science. Diploma / Degree in Industrial Safety from a recognized institute. Certifications such as ISO 45001 / NEBOSH / Process Safety preferred. Experience 8–10 years of experience in Health & Safety within manufacturing plants. Experience in Alcobev, Chemical, Pharma, FMCG, or hazardous manufacturing industries preferred. Experience handling statutory compliance, regulatory liaison, and hazardous process safety . Key Competencies Strong knowledge of hazardous factory regulations and statutory compliance . Expertise in process safety, fire safety, and incident investigation . Strong analytical and reporting skills for monthly safety metrics and KPIs . Ability to implement global safety policies at site level . Strong leadership and communication skills to drive safety culture . Flexible Working Statement: Flexibility is key to our success.
